question: A person buys a ceiling fan for Rs. 2,200 and sells it at a loss of 35%. What is the selling price of the ceiling fan?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Selling Price (SP) = (100 − Loss%) of Cost Price (CP)

⇒ SP = (100 − 35)% of 2200

⇒ SP = 65% of 2200

⇒ SP = (65 ÷ 100) × 2200

⇒ SP = 65 × 22 = 1430

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1430.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) of the ceiling fan = Rs. 2200

Loss percentage = 3
